name: Text-X
description: Text-X is a simple, clean, minimalist blog for Bludit flat-file CMS. A free Bludit template with Bootstrap 5.3.9, cover image, static pages, sidebar, and social links. Fast, no-database, SEO-ready, and fully compatible with Bludit 3.22.0.

features.2: Cover image ready for posts and pages.
features.6: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
features.7: SEO-ready and fast with Bludit flat-file CMS.

features_de.2: Coverbild bereit für Beiträge und Seiten.

Rápida, sin base de datos, lista para SEO y totalmente compatible con Bludit 3.22.0.
